name: Forceful Riding
body:
You have a riding style that relies more on power than finesse.

Benefit: When mounted, you steer with your might and stay on with your leg muscles. Riding is less about oneness with the animal for you and more of a wrestling match.

You may use your Strength modifier instead of your Dexterity modifier on Ride skill checks.
